Top Ability (Civic Effect): Resource Surge: Collect 2 additional resources than normal (limit 1 per space) when performing a resource collection action.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Routing Army: Apply a tactical bonus to your combat rolls if you have eliminated at least as many units as the enemy.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Rapid Construction: Decrease the resource or token cost of building a city settlement or specialized building by 1.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Desperate Defense: Retain a unit that would otherwise be destroyed if fighting inside your own borders.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Free Swap: Instantly exchange up to 3 resources of one type for another type at a 1:1 ratio without using a trade action.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Supply Lines: Roll an extra die during combat if your army is directly adjacent to a friendly city.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Tax Harvest: Gain 1 Gold for every two specialized buildings you control on the board.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Financial Incentive: Spend 1 Gold to add +1 to your highest combat die result.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Scouting Report: Move a land army up to 2 spaces across mountain or forest tiles, completely ignoring movement penalties.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): High Ground Combat: Prevent the enemy from activating or resolving any unit clash abilities during this combat round.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Blitz Move: Perform an additional free Move action with one army group outside your normal 3 turn actions.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Flanking Maneuver: Add +1 to your army's total combat strength if you attacked from an adjacent land space.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Sailing Fleet: Move up to two Ships for free, or transport an extra unit across a sea hex without consuming extra movement points.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Boarding Party: In naval combat, immediately destroy 1 enemy Ship if your roll matches or beats theirs.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Reinforce: Immediately replace a casualty or recruit 1 Infantry unit directly into a city currently under siege.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Wall Defense: Add a flat +2 defensive value to your combat total if defending a city with a Fortification.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Denial of Progress: Pay 1 Culture token to select an opponent; they receive 1 fewer action on their upcoming turn.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Confusion: Force the opponent to completely reroll their highest combat die before applying modifiers.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Spy Network: Look at an opponent's hand of action or objective cards, and choose one for them to discard.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Sabotaged Supplies: Force the enemy to subtract -1 from all combat dice rolled this round.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Soft Power: Increase your total distance for a Cultural Influence action by 1 space, ignoring neutral border constraints.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Ideological Defection: If you win the battle, immediately convert 1 surviving enemy infantry unit to your color.

Top Ability (Civic Effect): Non-Aggression: Stop an enemy army from entering a hex containing your units for the duration of the current round.
Bottom Ability (Combat Tactic): Feigned Retreat: End the combat round early; both armies must immediately step back 1 space without further casualties.
